note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/api/a2a.reason: The episode display joins the generated artifact-renderer map. `@cinatra-ai/podcast-artifacts` (cinatra#3093, epic #3087 wave 5) is registered as a development extension, and its two renderer slots — detail and preview — are emitted into src/lib/generated/artifact-renderers.ts behind the optional-import guard, exactly as the one other guardedOptional display already is. The five modules are that display's own value leaves and nothing else: the two renderer entries, the episode card they share, the episode view model behind it, and the content-channel leaf the view model reads (the renderer-props leaf is a type-only import and costs nothing). Every tracked route reaches the generated map through the artifact renderer dispatch spine, so all four grow by the same five. ATTRIBUTED BY MEASUREMENT, not computed and not hand-merged: in ONE environment, with the companion extension fleet cloned PINNED (115/115, missingCount 0) and an identical scripts/route-graph.mjs, the SAME tree was measured TWICE — with the two generated renderer entries removed it measures 1748 (/api/mcp), 1849 (/chat), 1756 (/api/a2a) and 1766 (/api/llm-bridge), i.e. each route's committed ceiling EXACTLY, and with them present it measures each ceiling + 5, this route (/api/a2a) included. Narrowing is not available and would defeat the change: a display is reachable only through the generated map, and a guardedOptional package takes no workspace dependency edge that could resolve it another way — the growth IS the display this wave ships. This raise RETIRES the previous record for this route, whose ceiling it moves.
